facts.fact: Econostrum reports that Algeria's national statistics office (ONS) published a demography report for 2020-2023 built on an exhaustive survey of the communes' civil-status services covering births, deaths, stillbirths and marriages.
The ONS demography report for 2020-2023 gives births registered (under 900,000 in 2023) and deaths (192,000 in 2023) from the communes' civil-status services, per Econostrum.

facts.fact: The ONS bulletin Démographie algérienne 2020 à 2023 (N°1030), imprint July 2024, reports 895,000 live births, 192,000 deaths and 278,000 marriages for 2023, and speaks of births falling below 900,000 'enregistrements', i.e. vital events from civil registration; as_of is the publication date (July 2024), the figures cover 2023.
